claim_scope: Public deterministic synthetic corpus only. The separately preregistered holdout is no longer blind.

methodology.geometry: Fresh build and audit of each frozen recipe, independent exact Fraction-based section topology/area/containment/volume checks, plus the CLI closed-domain determinant certificate.
methodology.quality: Per-solid maximum 2-norm Jacobian condition number sampled on the closed 5x5x5 parameter grid; candidate and prototype samples are diagnostics only, not continuous certificates. The prototype also records an in-plane 5x5 sample.
methodology.failures: Refusals, build errors, audit failures, invalid geometry and timeouts remain in the fixed 45-case denominator.
methodology.prototype: Thirty archived prototype block-count and sampled-condition observations are embedded as literals. Their source archive is not read at runtime; the prototype did not provide the kernel's continuous certificate.
methodology.supplemental: Twelve additional deterministic geometries are generated with the standard library, checked with the Rust CLI and independent exact section oracle, then volume is cross-checked against direct exact shoelace-area integration.
